climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A red DOCG from Piedmont made from Barbera, from a zone of communes in the province of Asti where conditions suit Barbera's ripening. It was called Barbera d'Asti Superiore Nizza before 2014.
